subject: Money
title: NFT Mania
description: A quick win: understand NFT Mania.

hook.text: In March 2021, a digital image by Beeple sold for $69 million at Christie's. It was a JPEG.

buildup.text: NFTs—non-fungible tokens—proved ownership of digital items on the blockchain. Art, music, tweets became collectibles.

discovery.text: NFT trading volume hit $25 billion in 2021. Celebrities, brands, and amateurs all created and sold digital art.

twist.text: By 2023, 95% of NFTs were worth nothing. The JPEG you bought for $10,000 couldn't sell for $10.

climax.text: NFTs had real use cases—tickets, identity, contracts—but speculation drowned them in hype and fraud.

quiz.question: What happened to 95% of NFTs by 2023?
